svg.text: Idle sawmill: the plank saw (row 2), round 3: rectangular blades sliding left and right, by level
R1 Plates in an open frame
the open tower of round 1, but each blade is a plain rectangular plate with a toothed edge that slides left and right through two blue posts; 1, 2 or 3 plates by level
the plates are held by two orange end bars; the whole sash slides sideways between the posts like a frame saw lying on its side, so the blades visibly belong together
R3 Plates sliding out of cabinets
the blades come out of one blue cabinet and back, only the part between the cabinets shows; the fewest details of all
